areas.title: Explainable AI
areas.description: Bridging the gap between mechanistic interpretability and symbolic reasoning to create more trustworthy AI systems. My research focuses on reverse-engineering neural networks into symbolic concepts through logic-guided circuit discovery, sparse autoencoders, and provable GNN explanations.

areas.title: Responsible AI
areas.description: Researching responsible approaches to AI development with respect to ethics, safety, and societal impact. With my colleagues, we assess XAI techniques for AI governance, deriving explainability desiderata from the EU AI Act.

areas.title: Custom AI Solutions
areas.description: Developing custom AI solutions based on state-of-the-art LLM stack (with RAG, agents, evals, etc.), as well as domain-specific data-based machine learning solutions.
